# Why won't my IIF file import into QuickBooks?

> Free QuickBooks Desktop IIF checker: finds why an IIF import fails or posts wrong (missing ENDTRNS, transactions that do not balance, stray tabs, bad dates, Excel quotes, unknown accounts), with line numbers, and writes a repaired file. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
